summary.intent: Run Session 1 of the LAUNCH-v1-alpha plan in the callisto repo: implement F1 (Seed/Source in aggregation so retained prerelease changesets don't erase fresh inference) and F2 (release-PR decide driven by the version plan), with G's pre.json v2/v3 reader as a parallel subagent.
summary.outcome: F1 was implemented, tested, linted, and committed (signed, 8be427806) with a changeset; its full-suite run and fresh-context review were still pending. F2 core edits (pending-release decide, decision schema v3, E165 set comparison, specs/docs) were made and compiled but two tests were still failing and it was uncommitted; G's storage was committed on its own branch.

repo: Aggregation now holds `seeds: BTreeMap<PackageId, Seed>` with `Source` variants (FreshChangeset, RetainedChangeset, Inference, Group); severities()/reasons() are derived, replacing the old `severities`/`reasons`/`named_by` fields and the `NamedBy` enum.

In pre mode, a retained (already-recorded in pre.json) changeset sets severity but releases nothing; a package is released only if it has at least one fresh source, including group unions driven by fresh members.

Repo gate is `just pre-push && just lint && just doc-check && just test`; tests run via cargo nextest (1924 tests in callisto-graph/cli), which is slow, so builds are throttled via CARGO_BUILD_JOBS and debug=0 env vars through a wrapper script.

Behavioral changes require spec/doc updates: docs/specs/versioning.json, cli.json, release.json, docs/adr/0002, docs/architecture/release.md, docs/releasing.md, docs/errors.md; and a changeset created via `callisto add`.
Removing a diagnostic code (inferred-release-without-changeset) requires also removing it from the schema_guard_test list.
Commits are signed and messages are written from a file; worktrees live under .claude/worktrees/wp-* per work package.

code.finding: Seed holds a non-empty first+rest entries; reason() picks first fresh source at highest fresh severity; union_fixed/union_linked were merged into one freshness-aware implementation.

E165 failure NoChangesetConsumed was renamed ConsumedChangesetsDiffer and now compares deleted changesets against those recorded in the v3 decision; reason_from_bump now errors on a missing reason instead of defaulting to Changeset.
ReleasePrDecisionV2::derive now takes Option<&PendingRelease> instead of a has_changesets bool, so inferred-only changes open a release PR.

friction: Full test suite is very slow (1924 tests), delaying F1 verification.
The G subagent repeatedly re-sent the same report and had to be stopped.
The first two combined git fetch/gh/worktree commands were duplicated and a later one needed rewriting, wasting calls.
F1's full run exposed one existing test that pinned the old F02 behavior and had to be rewritten.
cargo fmt failures were caught by pre-push and needed a rerun.
open_items: F2's two failing tests (investigated around intent.rs and ReleasePrDecideReport) still need fixing before commit.
F1's full `just test` run and the fresh-context reviewer results are pending.
cargo-mutants mutation testing was planned for F1 but not yet run (availability was being checked).
F2 still needs verification, a changeset, and a commit; G's branch commit (8b70877) is held pending G's own work.
Session plan items H and M (trail #457/#458) remain; no trails were created.
